pages.text: A basic Enigmatic Extract can be made by putting a Glass Bottle onto a Mystical Campfire. From here, you can use it to make either an Enigmatic Extract that extracts vial ashes or virtuous ashes, which can be used to make Herbal Blends.

Enigmatic Extract that extracts vial ashes can be used to make Herbal Blends that provide negative status effects.$(br2)Enigmatic Extract that extracts virtuous ashes can be used to make Herbal Blends that provide positive status effects.
Using all 3 kinds of Enigmatic Extracts also allows you to replicate your $(l:sin_alignments/ashes_of_sin)ashes of sin$().
